annotations.title: What moves a place in Google Maps and AI answers

description: Maps Agent's published summary of what moves a local business up in Google Maps results (scope maps) or into AI assistants' answers (scope ai_answers), each factor with its method and public sources. Good for 'what matters most for ranking on Google Maps' or 'how does a business get into ChatGPT answers'. When the summary for a scope is not published yet, says so and returns the closest published pages to read with fetch.

scope.description: maps (default): the place in Google Maps and the local pack. ai_answers: being named in AI assistants' answers.
